moments.title: Halloween approaches!
moments.blurb: Halloween falls on Saturday, October 31st, with many themed events already underway or starting across the UK for the 'Halloweekend' and half-term.

angles.name: Spooky Season Kick-Off
angles.copy: Ghouls and ghosts assemble! Halloween is just over two weeks away, and the UK is already getting into the spirit with spooky events and pumpkin patches popping up everywhere. What are your plans for the scariest night of the year? #Halloween2026

angles.name: Family Frights
angles.copy: With October half-term overlapping with Halloween for much of the UK, it's the perfect time for family frights! From theme park scare-fests to local pumpkin picking, how are you celebrating?

angles.name: Derry Halloween
angles.copy: Did you know Derry Halloween is considered Europe's largest Halloween festival? They're celebrating their 40th anniversary this year with four days and nights of folklore, fire, and frights!

moments.title: October Half-Term Underway
moments.blurb: October half-term is currently running in Scotland (Oct 12-16) and begins for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland from October 26-30, bringing a burst of family activities nationwide.

angles.name: Scottish Half-Term
angles.copy: It's the last day of half-term for our Scottish listeners! Hope you've had a fantastic week of autumn adventures. What's been the highlight for you and the family?

angles.name: Anticipating Half-Term
angles.copy: For those in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland, half-term is just around the corner, starting October 26th! Time to start planning those autumn outings.

moments.title: Exmoor Dark Skies Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The Exmoor Dark Skies Festival kicks off today, October 16th, running until November 1st, offering stargazing events and outdoor activities in one of the UK's designated Dark Sky areas.

angles.name: Stargazing on Exmoor
angles.copy: Look up tonight, Devon! The Exmoor Dark Skies Festival starts today, inviting you to explore the wonders of the night sky. Perfect for a crisp autumn evening.

angles.name: Embrace the Darkness
angles.copy: Away from city lights, Exmoor's Dark Skies Festival offers a chance to reconnect with the cosmos. Running until November 1st, it's a stellar seasonal event.

moments.title: BFI London Film Festival Nears End
moments.blurb: The 70th BFI London Film Festival continues until Sunday, October 18th, with a packed schedule of premieres, international films, and talks across the capital.

angles.name: Last Chance for LFF
angles.copy: Final call for film buffs! The BFI London Film Festival wraps up this Sunday. Still time to catch a premiere or a talk from a cinematic legend. What have you seen so far?

angles.name: London's Cinematic Hub
angles.copy: London has been the centre of the film world for the past week, and the BFI London Film Festival is still going strong until Sunday. Don't miss out!

moments.title: Frieze London Continues
moments.blurb: Frieze London, one of the world's most influential contemporary art fairs, is running in Regent's Park until Sunday, October 18th, showcasing leading galleries and artists.

angles.name: Art World Buzz
angles.copy: The art world is buzzing in Regent's Park! Frieze London is still open until Sunday, offering a chance to see groundbreaking contemporary art. Are you heading down?

angles.name: Contemporary Art Destination
angles.copy: From established masters to rising stars, Frieze London is a must for any art lover, and it's on until Sunday. Dive into the cutting edge of contemporary art.

moments.title: J. Cole Takes Over The O2
moments.blurb: J. Cole brings 'The Fall Off' tour to London's O2 Arena for two massive shows on October 19th and 20th, supporting his album of the same name.

angles.name: Cole World in London
angles.copy: J. Cole is set to light up The O2 with 'The Fall Off' tour this Monday and Tuesday! London's ready for two nights of pure hip-hop energy.

angles.name: Anticipation Builds
angles.copy: Next week, J. Cole delivers 'The Fall Off' live at The O2. If you're going, get ready for hits and tracks from his latest album!

moments.title: Amy Winehouse Band: Back To Black Live
moments.blurb: The Amy Winehouse Band will perform 'Back To Black' in full with special guests including Jorja Smith and Corinne Bailey Rae at London's Roundhouse on October 21st, curated by Mark Ronson.

angles.name: Tribute to a Legend
angles.copy: A special night is coming to the Roundhouse this Wednesday, as the Amy Winehouse Band, with guests like Jorja Smith, perform 'Back To Black' in full. A beautiful tribute to an icon.

angles.name: Back To Black Anniversary
angles.copy: Mark Ronson curates a unique show at the Roundhouse on Oct 21st, celebrating Amy Winehouse's 'Back To Black' album with her original band and guest vocalists. An unmissable event for fans.

moments.title: James Blake's 'Trying Times' UK Tour
moments.blurb: James Blake brings his 'Trying Times' tour across the UK this October, with dates including Glasgow (Oct 21), Manchester (Oct 25-26), and Bristol (Oct 28-29).

angles.name: Electronic Vibes
angles.copy: Immersive electronic sounds are coming to Glasgow, Manchester & Bristol this month as James Blake's 'Trying Times' tour hits the UK. Catch him live starting next week!

angles.name: Glasgow Gig
angles.copy: Glasgow, get ready for James Blake! He's bringing his 'Trying Times' tour to the city on Wednesday, October 21st. Who's got tickets?

moments.title: Westlife Live in Birmingham
moments.blurb: Irish pop sensations Westlife are performing live at Utilita Arena Birmingham tonight, October 16th.

angles.name: Tonight in Birmingham
angles.copy: Are you ready, Birmingham? Westlife are bringing their iconic pop hits to the Utilita Arena tonight! Get ready for a night of nostalgia.

angles.name: Pop Legends Live
angles.copy: Westlife are still filling arenas! If you're seeing them in Birmingham tonight, prepare for all the classics that defined an era.

moments.title: Michael Jackson Tops 2026 Album Chart
moments.blurb: Michael Jackson's 'The Essential Michael Jackson' is the UK's best-selling album of 2026 year-to-date, 17 years after his passing, fueled by renewed interest from his 2026 biopic.

angles.name: King of Pop Reigns
angles.copy: The King of Pop still reigns! Michael Jackson's 'The Essential' is the UK's best-selling album of 2026 so far, proving his enduring legacy.

angles.name: Biopic Boost
angles.copy: Driven by the success of his new biopic, Michael Jackson's greatest hits album has outsold current stars to top the year-to-date chart. Incredible!

angles.name: Thriller and Bad Return
angles.copy: It's not just 'The Essential' – Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' and 'Bad' also feature in the UK's Top 20 albums. The power of a legend!

moments.title: Nobody Wants This S3 on Netflix
moments.blurb: The third season of the popular romcom series 'Nobody Wants This' is set to premiere on Netflix on Thursday, October 22nd.

angles.name: Romcom Return
angles.copy: Get ready for more laughs and love! Season 3 of the romcom 'Nobody Wants This' drops on Netflix next Thursday, October 22nd. Who's excited?

angles.name: New Netflix Drop
angles.copy: Your next binge-watch is arriving soon! 'Nobody Wants This' Season 3 hits Netflix next week. Perfect for a cosy night in.

moments.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones in 'Kill Jackie'
moments.blurb: Welsh star Catherine Zeta-Jones leads the new gripping Prime Video series 'Kill Jackie', which premiered October 2nd, playing a former criminal targeted by assassins.

angles.name: Welsh Icon Action
angles.copy: Our very own Catherine Zeta-Jones is back on screen in the action-packed Prime Video series 'Kill Jackie'! She even keeps her Welsh accent playing an international drug smuggler. Have you watched it yet?

angles.name: Must-Watch Thriller
angles.copy: If you're looking for a gripping new series, Catherine Zeta-Jones stars in 'Kill Jackie' on Prime Video. It's a high-octane thriller you won't want to miss.

moments.title: Formula 1 US Grand Prix
moments.blurb: Formula 1 heads to Austin, Texas for the United States Grand Prix weekend from October 23rd-25th, with qualifying on Saturday 24th and the race on Sunday 25th.

angles.name: Stateside Showdown
angles.copy: Get ready for high-speed action! F1 is in Austin for the US Grand Prix next weekend. Who are you backing for pole position and the win?

angles.name: Race Weekend Prep
angles.copy: The F1 US Grand Prix is just a week away! Qualifying on Saturday, race on Sunday. Get set for an electrifying weekend of motorsport.

moments.title: FA Cup Fourth Round Qualifying
moments.blurb: The FA Cup Fourth Round Qualifying matches are taking place tomorrow, October 17th, as teams battle for a spot in the First Round Proper.

angles.name: Cup Action
angles.copy: The magic of the FA Cup continues tomorrow with the Fourth Round Qualifying! Non-league teams dreaming of glory. Which local clubs are you cheering on?

angles.name: Road to Wembley
angles.copy: Another step on the road to Wembley! The FA Cup qualifying rounds are always full of upsets and drama. Keep an eye on tomorrow's results!

moments.title: Keith Urban's 59th Birthday
moments.blurb: Country music superstar Keith Urban celebrates his 59th birthday on October 26th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Keith
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 59th Birthday to the incredible Keith Urban on October 26th! What's your favourite hit from the country-pop crossover star?

angles.name: Country Icon
angles.copy: He's brought us so many great songs! Keith Urban turns 59 next Monday. Get ready for some of his smooth tracks on the airwaves.

moments.title: Bootsy Collins' 75th Birthday
moments.blurb: Funk music legend and bassist Bootsy Collins turns 75 on October 26th.

angles.name: Funkadelic Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to groove! The iconic Bootsy Collins celebrates his 75th birthday on October 26th. What's your favourite Parliament-Funkadelic track?

angles.name: Bass Legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday next Monday to the one and only Bootsy Collins! His basslines shaped funk forever. Expect some serious funk on the airwaves!

moments.title: Natalie Merchant's 63rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter Natalie Merchant, known for her work with 10,000 Maniacs and her solo career, celebrates her 63rd birthday on October 26th.

angles.name: Alternative Icon
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the brilliant Natalie Merchant on October 26th! From 10,000 Maniacs to her powerful solo work, she's a true alternative icon.

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: Next Monday, we celebrate the birthday of Natalie Merchant! Her distinctive voice has soundtracked decades. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Judge Jules' 61st Birthday
moments.blurb: Influential British DJ and record producer Judge Jules (Julius O'Riordan) turns 61 on October 26th.

angles.name: Legendary DJ
angles.copy: Raise your hands for Judge Jules! The legendary DJ celebrates his 61st birthday on October 26th. Get ready for some classic trance and dance anthems!

angles.name: Trance Icon
angles.copy: Next Monday, we're wishing a very Happy Birthday to the iconic Judge Jules! A true pioneer of the UK dance scene.

moments.title: Keith Hopwood's 80th Birthday
moments.blurb: Keith Hopwood, rhythm guitarist for the iconic 1960s band Herman's Hermits, celebrates his 80th birthday on October 26th.

angles.name: 60s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday next Monday to Keith Hopwood of Herman's Hermits! A true legend of the 60s British Invasion. What's your favourite Hermits track?

angles.name: Pop Pioneer
angles.copy: Celebrating a milestone! Keith Hopwood, rhythm guitarist for Herman's Hermits, turns 80 on October 26th. Still 'A Kind of Hush' about his genius!
